title: No Iranian Ever Called Me Goyim:  the Tragedy of Zionism and America
author: Stephen Martin
content:
> No Vietnamese ever called me nigger
>
> – Muhammad Ali
>
> [Military men are just dumb, stupid animals to be used as pawns in foreign
> policy.](https://www.azquotes.com/quote/399150)
>
> – Henry Kissinger

Ragged trousered philanthropy is of the quintessence of colonialism so it goes
as under the dictates of necrotrophic resource transfer, and there is little
to no doubt that America is tragically going down and further to sink into a
hell polymorphous by way of any prognosis taking cognisance of what just
happened, and is happening now _via_ an illegal war waged against Iran. In the
background as in the shadows or fog of war are of course Russia and China.
Donald John Trump is about to precipitate the culmination of his manifold
personal bankruptcies as the most degenerate 'reptile' yet to step up
treasonously to the presidential plate. 'Whatever happened to baby Jane?'
indeed must remain on Epstein Island under compromat as much as redaction- and
one thing for sure is that the pictures and videos are truly fugly, so much so
that it is not in the public interest that they be revealed. So let's have a
wag the dog war to distract; the problem is as per the script of the film
based upon Larry Beinhart's sublime novel; Iran ain't no Albania, and the
opposing dog got real teeth and is vicious when it wants to be. The eyes and
ears of America in the Middle East have been blinded as deafened by precision
strikes, American military bases have been destroyed across the colonial
states as regimes (there still hotels yet solong as the regimes survive), and
Israel's Iron Dome is in shreds. Meanwhile 'laundry fires' aside the pride of
the American Navy is reduced to retreating strategically out with range,
eating rations which under logistics and budget are 'constrained'. 'I could
have been a contender Jonny' indeed. The highly expensive massing of some 60k
troops is about to reiterate some tragic parallel of the charge of the Light
Brigade as will constitute no surprise to the combined intelligence of Iran,
Russia and China concerning the hubris of the 'American' Empire precipitated
by the Don. They know exactly where 'they' are and have just the weaponry to
deliver devastation. 'Bring 'em on' indeed, lets have a turkey shoot' -but no
fucking way will Israeli troops be joining in…

The necrotrophs are _en ville_ by way of what has become a global village
which has to be destroyed in order to save it such the irony as arose from the
war on Vietnam - which is about to be dwarfed as an ignominious failure
concerning 'Operation Epic Failure' and the combined might of Iran, Russia and
China acting in concert against Zionism and Greater Israel and the
geopolitical control of the Middle East. The charge of the Light Brigade will
occur with an immediacy which will place Operation Barbarossa into the relief
retrospective of being protracted, not by numbers but in the immediacy of
devastation of illusion concerning military power exercised at a distance.
Certainly it will occur by way of the destruction of highly expensive
technology. There will be no Stalingrad or Kharg Island this time around; the
pawns as dumb stupid animals/ American Goyim are about to be wiped off the
board as pertains to the theater of the illegally declared war on Iran which
ain't about to be no Gaza. 'Where did they get such intelligence' where did
they get such technology?'Indeed.

There is no rejoice here at such a prognosis; for it is ordinary people the
world over that will suffer under such a hubris when it was in retrospect so
fucking unnecessary. The vast majority of humans are benign - if they can't do
you a good they will do you no harm, and the very concept of racial
superiority is repugnant to any thinking being not raised under Talmudic
precept.

Unfortunately, under _ordo ab chao_ , _divid et impera_ and Zionist
Colonialism the world is progressing rapidly to become a shithole of satanic
proportionality. America has enjoined Israel as a pariah; as a rogue state
against live and let live rationality. The tragedy is in the euphemism of
collateral damage. We have thereby been made or rendered but ragged trousered
philanthropists under what amount to satanism, and if we can survive are truly
in for a rough ride.

Render unto Satan indeed, but permit the rest of us to live in peace and
harmony…
